title: aibridge_scratch leaves orphan powershell agent.ps1 probes (15 on JIS-NB 11-06..11-10, ~1000 s CPU each; laptop A same). Parent test process dies before teardown, likely the 300 s per-file cap (99d903d5) killing pytest without its children. Fix: start probe in a Job Object / kill tree on cap; test that no aib_probe_ process survives a capped run
